title: Dogberry and Verges are Scared is a new look at Much Ado ⭐️⭐️⭐️
transcript: Dogberry and verges are scared is essentially rozenkrants and gildonstern are dead but for much ado about nothing. These secondary characters and much ado about nothing contemplate their role in the larger goings on of much ado, specifically with the hero subplot. This is described sort of as a dumb and dumber of sorts of the shakespearean world. Daggerberry and verges are incredibly unintelligent characters with hearts of gold. And because so much of the humor was a little bit on the stupid side, it didn't always land for me. there were genuine heartfelt moments in this that really won me over. And by the end of the play, I really cared about these characters and the journey that they had gone on. Overall, this was a fun new look at much ado about nothing, one of my favorite Shakespeare plays. If you love those characters, definitely check this out. This is playing at the Sea Arts Sea Aurora venue through the rest of fringe.
